title: THE FIND SOUNDS STOP RINGING
why: His note of 2026-10-12: the sound after finding rarer items lingers for too long. The find chimes themselves were short, but every one went into the room reverb, which inside a building, in a vault and in the Undercroft kept a bright chime ringing for another second or more after its notes ended, and a jackpot pulled item by item smeared one ring into the next. A green, blue, purple or gold find (and the gun pickup) now plays dry, with no room echo, so it is over when its notes are: inside about half a second for green and blue and under a second for purple and gold. The notes are the same, so a purple still sounds better than a blue, and a new find cuts the one still ringing so two in a row never stack. Menu clicks keep their sound.
now: A rare find now rings short and dry, with no echo hanging on after it.
